entries.exactPassage: Myah presents last. Her complete Financial Independence Plan. Life vision. Current situation. Goals with failure signals. Income strategy with control scores. Investing plan with fee analysis. Protection. Tax. Retirement from age 20 — projected over R3 million by 65. Estate. Systems. Ethics. Her sweet spot — financial education for young people. "This plan is not just about money. It is about the life I want to build. And now I know how to build it."
entries.concern: The story gives a projected retirement amount without contribution, rate, fee, inflation or tax assumptions. It is a model case, not a verified forecast for learners.
entries.proposedWording: Retirement from age 20 — a case projection that depends on stated contributions, returns, fees, inflation and tax assumptions. Explain those assumptions before using an amount as a comparison or expectation.
entries.implementationImpact: Separate owner-reviewed contextual wording proposal. No source wording, question, response key, figure or canonical block is changed in this batch.
